answer_1.quote: We conducted a large-scale human evaluation of hallucinated content in systems that use Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and Transformers, as well as human written summaries for the recently introduced eXtreme SUMmarization task (XSUM, ...

answer_2.quote: We report on ROUGE (Lin and Hovy, 2003) scores, BERTScore and semantic inference metric such as textual entailment and question answering.

answer_4.quote: We have trained annotators (fluent in English) specifically for our assessment. Our annotators went through two pilot studies to have a better understanding of intrinsic and extrinsic hallucinations, and factuality of summaries.
answer_4.guideline: annotators were tasked with (i) identifying those text spans that were unfaithful to the article and (ii) for each text span, annotating whether the hallucination was intrinsic or extrinsic.
